value.draft: Children can participate in clinical trials, but it depends on the specific study. First, check the trial's inclusion criteria to see if there are age restrictions. Some trials are specifically designed for pediatric populations, while others may include children within a broader age range. It's also important to confirm whether the trial has processes in place for parental consent and child assent, as these are required for minors to participate. Always ensure that the trial meets ethical standards and protects the rights and well-being of child participants.
